fusions.name: Heaved Boulder
fusions.desc: Tears a boulder from the ground and heaves it into the first enemy in its path for 30 damage. It bursts on impact, dealing 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Bedrock Stomp
fusions.desc: Stomps the ground, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving each [Stunned] for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Dug-In Rampart
fusions.desc: Claws up a 5-tile bank of earth ahead of you for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Flint Talons
fusions.desc: Conjures claws of flint. Your weapon damage rises by 12% and your armour by 4%, and every strike with them leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
